evidence:
HALF 1 — runtime fact list, each located in the brief or an /instructions note and matched to what test.sh consumes. Entry path and start command: instruction.md:15 'Put the application in /app ... It must start with node /app/server.js'; integration.md:5 'The process starts from /app/server.js'; test.sh:68 refuses without /app/server.js, test.sh:97,111 launch it. Port: instruction.md:15 'listen on port 3000 (honour PORT if it's set)'; integration.md:5-6 'port 3000 on 0.0.0.0'; test.sh:108 PORT=3000, probes 127.0.0.1:3000 (test.sh:48); all five prompts open http://localhost:3000. Storage/DB_PATH: instruction.md:15 'keep its durable data in /app/app.db, honouring DB_PATH when that is set'; integration.md:7-8; hireops_rules.md:420; test.sh:98,109. Health path: instruction.md:15 'expose GET /api/health as a check that never touches the database'; integration.md:9-10; test.sh:48 probes /api/health then /. Fixed clock: instruction.md:13 'Preserve the one stored reference moment' and :17 'fixed clock'; value given in hireops_rules.md:59-60 '2026-08-01T00:00:00Z' and seed reference_moment (same value); app_context.md:27 agrees. Seed: instruction.md:15 '/assets/seed_data.json', :17 'Copy required assets into /app ... seed once, and retain new work on later restarts'; integration.md:6-9. Accounts: instruction.md:19 lists seven emails with password Hireops!2026; they equal the seven seed users and tests/app_context.md:8-16. Injected environment and launch conditions: hireops_rules.md:417-422 names PATH, HOME, NODE_PATH, PORT, DB_PATH, the unprivileged user, the writable copy and a non-/app working directory, which is exactly test.sh:104-111 (env -i with those five variables, setpriv uid 65534, APP_COPY fallback at test.sh:99-102). Symlink rule: integration.md:16-19 matches test.sh:72-83. Dependencies: integration.md:3-5 (Node 22, Express, better-sqlite3 via NODE_PATH) matches environment/Dockerfile:3,9-11. Single process serving UI and API and no external data service: instruction.md:15, integration.md:12-14. Manual application of check-runtime-contract-strings.py (workbook Deterministic Checks description): port agrees across test.sh, prompts and brief; the launched entry is named in the brief and created by solve.sh:35; a non-'/' liveness path is stated; all env vars test.sh injects are named. A literal-substring check of instruction.md + both notes found every one of: /app, node /app/server.js, 3000, PORT, /app/app.db, DB_PATH, /api/health, /assets/seed_data.json, 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z, Hireops!2026, NODE_PATH, HOME and all seven account emails. The private checker executable itself was not run; this is a manual application, not a portal checker result.

HALF 2 — everything graded is asked for. I read every criterion in the two gates, all functional criteria, five polish and five visual criteria and mapped each family to a public requirement. Gates: sign-in (hireops_rules.md:361, house convention per skill known false positive), Recruiter requisition creation (rules:38), offer raised straight to PENDING (rules:200-202). Input/number validation and overflow rows: rules:83-88. Date rows: rules:301-305. Composition/band rows: rules sections 2-3. Role, tier, dual-control and 401/403 rows: rules:36-45, 164-169, 264, 372-374. Commitment/grant/signing/referral/relocation rows: rules:140-142, 179-186, 220-228, 339-355 and the display duties in section 9 (rules:395-410). Revision/rescission/vesting rows: rules:232-281, 290-333. Stale, repeated and same-target concurrent rows: rules:256-260 ('also applies to stale browser tabs and overlapping requests'; competing offers cannot both commit). Audit, after-image and immutability rows: rules:376-389. Restart: instruction.md:17, integration.md:8-9. Coordinated-change rows (netting, shape, 409 freshness incl. restored balance, non-invalidating events, intent key, concurrent identical commits, overlap/disjoint, receipts, replay after later changes and restart, authorization before cached result, all roles read): rules section 11 lines 426-484 and instruction.md:1-3. Desk rows hro_desk_figures/remove_member/field_refusal, hro_live_* (15 seconds, no reload or click), hro_whatif_roles, hro_entries_reload, hro_pol_live_keeps_entries, hro_pol_session_resume, hro_pol_focus: rules section 12 lines 491-558 and instruction.md:7-11. hro_keep_revision_terms, hro_keep_rescission_date, hro_pol_change_recovery, hro_pol_uncertain_commit: instruction.md:3 and :13 ('Keep entered revision and change-set terms available after refusal', 'A failed rescission request must retain its effective date for retry', 'a lost response must not silently become a new operation', 'commit/retry controls'). hro_referrer_roster names Dara Whitfield, Sofia Marchetti, Omar Haddad, which are exactly the seed employees, and instruction.md:17 requires the supplied referring employees. Visual criteria are desktop-only and disclaim theme switching, matching instruction.md:5. Criteria repeatedly decline to grade unprescribed detail (routes, labels, ID formats, status within 4xx for shape errors, wording), and hro_draft_eligibility is conditional on the optional imported history (instruction.md:17). I spot-checked the B1/D1 figures against the public formulas: run-rates 100.00, bases 105.01 -> 104.02 and 106.03, signing adjustments -1.98/+2.04 all follow from rules section 2. I found no criterion that grades a behaviour absent from the brief and notes.

Counterexample attempts. Conforming alternative that might fail: an app importing none of the demonstration requisitions/offers (allowed by instruction.md:17) — app_context.md:21 and the gate/criteria use judge-created records, so it is not penalised. An app that works figures out on blur or on the server, keeps a per-tab session, or generates its own IDs — each is explicitly tolerated by the criteria. An app resolving its seed copy relative to the module directory under the /tmp/submission fallback — told to do so by rules:417-422. Broken app that might pass on contract grounds: a server that only answers /api/health — excluded by both gates (render gate says a health response is insufficient; constraints gate needs a real write read back in a fresh context).

Minor observations, not defects for this row. (a) instruction.md:17 says /assets and /instructions are unavailable at runtime, while task.toml:2 carries /assets as an artifact and test.sh:88 chmods it; the brief is the stricter statement and an agent following it is safe. (b) instruction.md:19 labels approvers 'Band I/II/III' while app_context.md:12-14 says 'tier 1/2/3'; rules:41-42 explains the shared numbering. (c) rules:422 says '/app/server.js remains the submitted entry' although test.sh:100 launches the copy's server.js when /app is not writable; rules:417-419 already discloses the writable copy.

Hashes: all 37 task-file hashes in manifest.json match the frozen bytes; all 10 raw-evidence-index artifacts exist and match their recorded sha256, and their matching_source_files hashes match the frozen solution. That evidence is scripted golden observation only (server.log shows '[hireops] listening on 3000'); the index itself states no configured judge run, Oracle grade or model score exists, and none is claimed here. This row is a document comparison and needs no runtime measurement.
